def update(self, dt):
    if self.state in ("swing", "extend", "reel"):
        self.time_left -= dt
        if self.time_left <= 0:
            self.time_left = 0
            self.state = "gameover"
            return
    if self.state == "swing":
        self.phase += self.swing_speed * dt
        self.angle = AMP * math.sin(self.phase)
    elif self.state == "extend":
        self.length += 430 * dt
        tx, ty = self.tip()
        for it in self.items:
            if (tx-it.x)**2 + (ty-it.y)**2 <= (it.r+7)**2:
                self.grabbed = it
                self.state = "reel"
